standard_prerequisites.name: Stably free lifting
standard_prerequisites.use: Represents K by a bounded complex of free modules tensoring to the Koszul complex.

standard_prerequisites.name: Regular sequences
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts form a regular sequence with flat quotient.

core_obligations: Represent K by a complex whose reduction is exactly the Koszul complex; the components of the last arrow are the lifts f_i.
Build the comparison diagram to the Koszul complex on the lifts; regularity makes the southwest arrow a quasi-isomorphism, so the dotted arrow exists.
Reduce mod m: the reduction is an isomorphism by construction; a Tor computation over the residue field gives invertibility mod n, hence invertibility over the local ring A.
proof_roadmap: Lift, compare, reduce, and conclude by local invertibility; every step displayed.
difficulty_reason: Chain-complex lifting with a comparison diagram, reduction mod the maximal ideal, and a Tor computation; all displayed.
